description: This Java class, LogWrapper, implements a logging interface by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It facilitates chaining of log nodes for flexible logging outputs within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging with chaining capability through LogNode interfaces.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be sent after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then passes the log to the next node if available.
